name: Eternal Limited
headline: Eternal is a business that returned to profit after years of losses, holds more cash than debt and does not pay a dividend. Its size jumped in FY22, which can come from an acquisition, a merger or a large capital raise.

name: HDFC Bank Limited
headline: HDFC Bank is a consistently profitable business that has paid a dividend every year for the last ten years and has no controlling promoter. Its size jumped in FY24, which can come from an acquisition, a merger or a large capital raise.

name: Hyundai Motor India Ltd
headline: Hyundai Motor India is a steadily growing, consistently profitable business that carries very little debt, has paid a dividend every year for the last six years and is about 82% owned by its promoters.

name: Swiggy Limited
headline: Swiggy is a loss-making business that holds more cash than debt, does not pay a dividend and has no controlling promoter. Its size jumped in FY22, which can come from an acquisition, a merger or a large capital raise.

name: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd
headline: Tata Consultancy Services is a steadily growing, consistently profitable business that holds more cash than debt, has paid a dividend every year for the last ten years and is about 72% owned by its promoters.
